groupings.title: CX Operations — quality
groupings.description: Designing and validating support quality measurement — scorecards, calibration, sampling fairness, coverage economics, and programme maturity.

groupings.title: CX Operations — analytics and planning
groupings.description: Measuring automation, understanding why customers contact, and staffing to meet demand.

groupings.title: CX Operations — reporting and diagnosis
groupings.description: Turning one-off report requests into comparable series, and explaining why a metric moved without mistaking noise or a mix shift for performance.

groupings.title: CX Operations — coaching and calibration
groupings.description: Evidence an agent will accept as fair, and telling apart an ambiguous criterion from a grader who is simply harsher.

groupings.title: CX Operations — service levels and backlog
groupings.description: Modelling a response-time target before committing to it, and finding the conversations in a backlog that actually have someone waiting.

groupings.title: CX Operations — investigation and compliance
groupings.description: Establishing what actually happened and whether what customers were told matches what the company intends.

groupings.title: CX Operations — agent assist and AI safety
groupings.description: Reviewing replies, validating AI graders and copilots, prompt change control, grounding, human-in-the-loop gates, and bounding agentic actions.

groupings.title: CX Operations — monitoring and process
groupings.description: Turning a one-off search into a monitor that stays useful, and documenting performance to a standard that survives review.

groupings.title: CX Operations — operational metrics
groupings.description: The metrics teams report every week, defined so they survive scrutiny: resolution, handle time, routing and escalation.

groupings.title: CX Operations — channels and experience
groupings.description: Choosing channels, measuring self-service and effort, and the playbooks for incidents, tiers and accessibility.

groupings.title: CX Operations — workforce and vendors
groupings.description: Turning a forecast into a workable schedule, ramping new hires, and comparing outsourcers fairly.

groupings.title: CX Operations — cost, signal and content
groupings.description: What support costs, spotting an incident in contact volume before monitoring does, and keeping macros and tags trustworthy.

groupings.title: CX Operations — data and compliance
groupings.description: The canonical conversation schema every export in this catalog emits, platform migrations, and regulatory complaint handling.

groupings.title: Zendesk
groupings.description: Working with Zendesk Support and Suite: exporting at volume, and applying reviewed merge and erasure plans under the mutation safety contract.

groupings.title: Intercom
groupings.description: Working with Intercom conversations and Fin data, including the N+1 that message bodies force and the silent 500-part truncation.

groupings.title: Freshworks
groupings.description: Working with Freshdesk tickets and Freshchat conversations — two separate products with separate APIs, and two very different pagination traps.

groupings.title: Salesforce
groupings.description: Working with Service Cloud cases via Bulk API 2.0, including the three separate objects that hold case conversation text.

groupings.title: HubSpot
groupings.description: Working with Service Hub conversation threads, including the silent email truncation and the 30-day archive window.

groupings.title: Gorgias
groupings.description: Working with Gorgias tickets, which offer no time filter at all — incremental sync means a newest-first walk with an early stop.

groupings.title: Front
groupings.description: Working with Front conversations under a per-company rate limit low enough to change how you plan the whole export.

groupings.title: Five9
groupings.description: Working with Five9 contact centre interaction data through the reporting API, with time windowing around the 50,000-record cap.

groupings.title: Help Scout
groupings.description: Working with Help Scout Mailbox API v2, where the conversation list defaults to status=active and embedded threads are truncated by design.

groupings.title: Rulebase — getting connected
groupings.description: Getting access to Rulebase and wiring an AI client to it: accounts, data regions, the MCP server, and API keys.

groupings.title: Rulebase — operating a workspace
groupings.description: Querying, auditing and feeding a Rulebase workspace through the MCP server and the REST API.
